description.value: Queensborough Landing Liquor Store is a privately operated liquor retailer in New Westminster offering a wide selection of beer, wine, and spirits. It participates in the More Rewards loyalty program and runs monthly in-store specials and giveaways. Cyclists can also order for delivery via Skip the Dishes or DoorDash rather than visiting in person.

address.value: 805 Boyd St, New Westminster, BC V3M 5X2

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content is fully available and confirms the business is an active liquor store at 805 Boyd St, New Westminster, BC. The OSM record lists the community as 'Richmond' but the website clearly states the address is New Westminster — a discrepancy flagged below. No cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, washrooms, water refill) are mentioned anywhere on the website; takeout is effectively confirmed since customers purchase alcohol to take away, and delivery via Skip the Dishes and DoorDash is explicitly offered.
concerns: OSM community field lists 'Richmond' but the website address is clearly New Westminster, BC — the OSM record may be geolocated incorrectly or the community tag is wrong.
OSM record has no address or phone; both were sourced entirely from the website.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: This is a functioning retail liquor store that could be a useful stop for touring cyclists picking up beverages, but none of the three required WWC criteria (bike parking, water refill, washrooms) are confirmed from the website. A human reviewer should assess whether the location and shopping-centre context offer sufficient cyclist utility to warrant inclusion.
enrichment_extras.notes: Business is operated under license by Ennis Investments Ltd. and is a More Rewards (Pattison Food Group) partner location.

Packed lunches.detail: Alcohol-only retail; no food items sold
